newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 4.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following major business stories on April 4:

WASHINGTON - Columbia Gas System Inc. and three corporate partners announced plans to build a $600 million, 380-mile pipeline that would link to others to carry natural gas from western Canada, the Gulf of Mexico and the Rocky Mountain West to New York, Washington and other northeast markets.

WASHINGTON - America Online Inc. announced it has agreed to pay additional credits and refunds to subscribers who had trouble accessing the service after the company introduced unlimited use pricing late last year.

NEW YORK - Some late bargain-hunting spared the Dow Jones industrial average its fourth 100-point loss in five days, but investors remained hesitant as they waited for a pivotal employment report Friday.
WASHINGTON - A small Georgia company is trying to build a business wiring day care centers with cameras to enable parents to watch live images of their children over the Internet.
